sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# First, go back to position 1 (LEFT)
result = action(['LEFT'])
print(f"LEFT: board_changed={result.get('board_changed')}")

# Check cursor position
seg = current_frame.segmentation
white_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'W']
for n in white_nodes:
    cr = sum(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) / len(n['boundary'])
    cc = sum(p[1] for p in n['boundary']) / len(n['boundary'])
    print(f"  Cursor at ({cr:.0f},{cc:.0f})")

# Record current symbol hashes before UP
before_hashes = {}
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'B' and n['pixels'] < 30:
        cr = sum(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) / len(n['boundary'])
        before_hashes[(n['id'], cr)] = n['hash']

# Now press UP
result = action(['UP'])
print(f"\nUP: board_changed={result.get('board_changed')}")

# Check which symbols changed
after_hashes = {}
for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'B' and n['pixels'] < 30:
        cr = sum(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) / len(n['boundary'])
        after_hashes[(n['id'], cr)] = n['hash']

# Find changed symbols
print("\nChanged symbols at position 1:")
for key in before_hashes:
    if before_hashes[key] != after_hashes.get(key):
        nid, row = key
        print(f"  Node {nid} (row~{row:.0f}): {before_hashes[key]} -> {after_hashes.get(key)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
